frozen_before: any real calibration render or model forecast
priors: fixed object gray or red palette

fit.outline_source: pinned official pusht/pymunk_override.py draw_polygon hardcodes radius=2; used only for silhouette fitting, never coverage geometry

pixel_coordinates: OpenCV resize pixel centers: (index+0.5)*512/96-0.5; pygame vertices rounded to world pixels

contact_proxy.meaning: estimated geometry proximity only; never solver contact

abstention: Invalid input, missing components, area/shape/circle mismatch or partial scene clipping returns valid=false and no coverage. Never fill from truth or discard missing rows.
tuning: Configuration and algorithm fixed before real renders; calibration failures are reported without tuning. Synthetic-only implementation tests do not consume physics.
